what_this_is: The second run of the Milestone 5 Phase 1a availability probe, spec revision 2, exactly as the probe reported it. Availability metadata only: dates, counts, HTTP status codes, unit-free ratios and booleans; no price and no volume value.

run.ci_run_for_the_same_commit: NRE Milestone 1 #240, passed on attempt 1, both jobs (Python 3.12 and 3.13)

how_it_was_read: Read exactly as run 1 was: the probe prints its report as canonical JSON, gzip with a fixed modification time, base64, in workflow-command notices and one digest notice, which the public check-run annotations API serves without sign-in. They were fetched from /repos/Fahad9101/NRE/check-runs/113680369835/annotations and decoded with nre.m5_phase1a_probe.decode_annotations, which verifies the digest notice.

compared_with_run_1.meaning: The daily-bar, symbol-mapping, adjustment, feed, corporate-action and calendar results repeat exactly, 8 hours 46 minutes after run 1 (run 1 retrieved at 2026-10-08T20:25:36Z, run 2 at 2026-10-09T05:11:45Z).
what_revision_2_added: the 16:00 minute kept apart from the regular session and from after hours
a fifth ratio (the closing minute's share)
booleans on whether the daily open, high, low and close equal the all-hours or the regular-session minute values

known_limits_of_this_run: Six symbols on four ordinary Wednesdays of 2025 (23 sessions after the guard skipped one): thin for the issuers, whose extended-hours trading is sparse; a field can only be classified on a session where its candidates differ.
No early-close day and no event day was sampled.
The booleans compare the daily bar with minute bars from the same provider and feed; they say what the daily bar is made of, not whether either matches an official exchange price.
The daily bar is a snapshot as of the retrieval time; whether the provider revises historical bars after the fact (a vintage question) was not tested.
